# Ledger and Transactions

Rincoin transactions consume existing unspent transaction outputs and create
new outputs. Spending authority is evaluated under the applicable signature and
script rules. During block validation, full nodes verify that referenced inputs
are available and value-conserving and perform input-script checks before
updating the UTXO set [@rincoinCore2026deployed].

Each block contains a coinbase transaction that may claim no more than the
height-dependent subsidy plus transaction fees. Fees transfer existing RIN to
miners and are not new issuance. If a miner claims less than the maximum
permitted subsidy, the difference is not reissued
[@rincoinCore2026deployed].
